Confluence Path
Confluence Path
The Crusher boy's ladder — no lottery, no luck: the same grind, the same day, the same naira
Now
The hill is quiet — the boy comes down the trail on day 3. Till then, the city dey run.
The Path
● Patti Base
you dey here
Patti base — a small boy hails you: "Abeg, help me carry sand. I go share my cut. No be scam."
○ The Sand Days
ahead
Bucket by bucket, day by day — the boy counts your days, not your grammar. Three honest carries and he opens his notebook.
○ The Notebook
ahead
"My school fee don spoil my head," he says. ₦3,500 — or the school knows your name and waves the levy.
○ The Fever Night
ahead
The GRA hospital by night — the boy shakes with fever and the bill is ₦2,000. You pay. Nobody forgets who stood there.
○ The Sponsorship Desk
ahead
₦500 a day, six days straight at the GRA desk. Government work is slow — but it is steady, and it comes with respect.
○ The White Coat
ahead
The white coat fits. Confluence gold under the collar, and the Chairman Strut walks out through the hospital doors.
